features: Existing contexts return before creation-option access; module new-context calls map contextName/contextOrigin/contextCodeGeneration, native Script uses the matching option keys, and native createContext validates callback types while preserving default-loader constants.
Script execution options use the Script callback rather than installing or reading another context callback.
limitations: Last evaluated-context retirement #885 remains unresolved; no live-context filtering, cache flushing or weakened lifetime assertions are introduced.
Inspector context name/origin metadata, every import lifetime, all-platform/Release/ASAN and full Bun-suite completion remain unproven.
